dboxTimeline.speaker: Braska
dboxTimeline.text: Thank you for coming this far with me.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Jecht
dboxTimeline.text: Don't get soft on me now, Braska.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Young Auron
dboxTimeline.text: My lord. There has to be another way.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Braska
dboxTimeline.text: If there is, I never found it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Jecht
dboxTimeline.text: Then we go in loud. Like always.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: That was my old man. And Braska. And you.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Ten years ago.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Keep walking.
The statue's empty, you see.
Has been for ages. Nobody tells you that part

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: Empty? But the temple said the Final Aeon—

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: The temple says a great many things.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: You've walked a long way to be disappointed.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: Come closer, child.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: Lady Yunalesca. I've come for the Final Aeon.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: Then choose one of them. One you love.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: That is the price. It always was.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Kimahri
dboxTimeline.text: Kimahri.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: No. Me. Take me, ya?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: I'm no good at the rest of it anyway.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: Your father stood where you are standing.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: He chose quickly. He was kind about it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: And when the Aeon becomes Sin, another comes.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: And another. I have lost count

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Wait. Becomes Sin? Say that again.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: That's the plan? That's the whole plan?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: Forever?

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: Hope is comforting.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: It is also how I keep them walking.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: She killed me for asking that.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Ten years ago. Right there.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: No.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: Then you will die out there, in despair.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: I would rather it were here. And gentle.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: A thousand years.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: You are the first to say no.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: You are making this longer than it needs to be.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Everybody's grey! Is that bad?!

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Stay grey. Her kindness kills the living.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: Very well. No more kindness.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Stay as you are. Do not let her cure you.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: Rest now. All of you.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: At once.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: There. Now no one can summon it.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: Not ever again.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: I hope you find something better.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yunalesca
dboxTimeline.text: I never could.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: So that's it. Sin's still out there.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Wakka
dboxTimeline.text: And we got nothing.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Rikku
dboxTimeline.text: We got a no. That's not nothing.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Lulu
dboxTimeline.text: It's very close to nothing.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: It's a start.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Yuna
dboxTimeline.text: I'd rather start with nothing than end with this.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Kimahri
dboxTimeline.text: Yuna chose. Kimahri follows.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: Auron. Ten years ago.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: You said she killed you.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Hmph.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Auron
dboxTimeline.text: Now you're asking the right questions.

dboxTimeline.speaker: Tidus
dboxTimeline.text: That's not an answer!
That was the day we threw away the only plan.
I remember the quiet on the walk down.
I thought I was scared for Spira.
She looked lighter than she had in weeks.
